income_per_turn.v: sum over own cities: (level + base + 1 if capital + 1 if workshop + parks + min(0,population)) + market income; besieged city = 0; infiltrated city loses only its normal income once

stars.turn_start: income is applied at the START of your turn (not on turn 0)
stars.siege: an enemy unit standing on the city centre tile

level_up.v: population >= level+1 ; then population -= level+1 ; level+=1 ; reward choice is mandatory
level_up.note: WK Score page consistent: 50 pts per level.

city.territory: capital/city claims radius 1 (3x3) on founding; Border Growth claims free tiles to radius 2
city.capture: unit must START the turn on the city tile; consumes the unit's turn; supported units lose their origin city
city.village_to_city: unit starting turn on village; consumes turn; becomes level-1 city (pop 0)

clear_forest.effect: forest->field, +1 star (PE); wiki Forestry page says +2 stars, undated - C19

burn_forest.src: 2025 balance pass dev post (PE had 5, stale)
burn_forest.cost_src: GAME-UI (Jason's v123 info cards, 2026-10-23) (3, as in the 2025 patch notes; PolyEnv's 5 is stale)

road.effect: road on land/forest, own or neutral territory; wiki Roads page says 2, undated - C19
road.cost_src: GAME-UI (Jason's v123 info cards, 2026-10-23) (3, so PolyEnv is right; the undated wiki's 2 is wrong)

bridge.effect: bridge on shallow water between two land tiles (N-S or E-W)

Mine.note: PE header comment says 'Mine = 1' but code sets 2 (code trusted)

Port.ui_effect: Fishing: +1 pop; trade routes through Ocean/Water/Wetland to other Ports within 5 tiles; units moving here become boats

Forge.ui_effect: Smithery: +2 pop per nearby Mine; one per city

Windmill.ui_effect: Construction: +1 pop per nearby Farm/Aqua Farm; one per city

Market.income: stars/turn = sum of adjacent booster levels (cap 8)
Market.ui_effect: Trade: +1 star per turn for each nearby Windmill, Forge, Sawmill; one per city

buildings.booster_level: Forge = adjacent own Mines, Sawmill = adjacent Lumber Huts, Windmill = adjacent Farms (0..8)

Embassy.ui_effect: Diplomacy: income for both sides while not at war, doubled with a peace treaty

Temple.ui_effect: Free Spirit: +1 pop, 100 score, +100 score every 2 turns

Crater.ui_effect: Solaris (Heatwork): +1 pop; trade routes through Lava to other Craters within 5 tiles

Turbine.ui_effect: Solaris (Geothermics): +2 pop, must be on a Volcano tile

monuments.AltarOfPeace: 5 consecutive turns with no attack + Meditation
monuments.build: cost 0, +3 pop, +400 score, one of each per player

score.city: 100 + 50 per level above 1 + 5 per current population
score.pe_caveat: PE ScoreSystem.startingScore() is stubbed to 0 (commented-out table disagrees with Tribe.cpp). Use tribes.json for starting scores.

ruins.action: unit must START its turn on the ruin; uses the unit's turn; ruin disappears
ruins.PE_reward_pool: uniform pick from the AVAILABLE pool: Stars(+10), Tech (random obtainable), Population(+3 to capital, if capital owned), Explorer (if hidden tile in 5x5), VeteranUnit (Swordsman 20HP vet, or Rammer 15HP on water)
WK_reward_names: Scrolls of Wisdom: random researchable tech
Explorer (5x5 fog condition, not on mountains)
Rammer: Veteran Rammer carrying a Warrior (water)
Lost City: Aquarion, ocean, level-3 walled city
ruins.note: Wiki Ruin page (fetched 2026-10-23): uniform among eligible rewards, matching the PolyEnv pool. Real frequencies still untested (G4). The old 'Battleship/Super Unit' names are pre-2.0.58.
